title: ChamoSMP
description: ChamoSMP featuring SMP, and Duels (Coming Soon)!
body:
# Welcome to ChamoSMP

ChamoSMP is a network of gamemodes in this list:

- Economy SMP (Semi-factions like DonutSMP. beta whitelist)

- Duels (beta whitelist)

- Anarchy (coming soon)

# SMP
Play in a SMP featuring economy, base raiding and more! Become the richest, buillt the biggest bases and survive or become the most feared PVPer. Our server feautures and encourages Diamond SMP to be played and not other gamemoded in tier-lists

# Duels
Duels your friends in a arena with parties, randoms or just play alone. Get more ELO in ranked games and climb the leaderbords to become the best. Train every day to become better and better.

# Anarchy
Coming Soon!

To contact support please contact us on our Discord Server. We are not affiliated with Mojang Studios in any way
